Park Plaza Eindhoven offers 104 stylish rooms and suites in the heart of the City of Light, within walking distance of Central Station, Van Abbemuseum, and Strijp, the hotel is ideal for business trips and weekend escapes.As a Front Office Host(ess), you will ensure guests feel welcome and cared for throughout their stay by delivering warm, attentive service at every interaction.
